tagline: A tiny stub pack — enough albums to prove you can duplicate the template.
intro:
This is **not** a finished Ween map. It exists so a new band is a folder, not a rewrite of the app. Copy `content/ween`, rename the slug, and replace these three placeholders.

When someone writes the real Ween pack, start at *GodWeenSatan* or *Chocolate and Cheese* and fan out toward *The Mollusk*.

startAlbums.label: GodWeenSatan: The Oneness
startAlbums.hint: The noisy first door. Replace this stub when the real pack lands.

lanes.label: Nautical
lanes.blurb: The Mollusk's sea-shanty psych — a taste lane waiting for more edges.

footerBlurb: Stub pack on purpose. Duplicate this folder to add a real Ween (or any other) catalog in about fifteen minutes.
